name: Ashen knight Pyke Ability Icons V1 by El0mEnati
creator: el0menati
description:
Replaces Pyke’s ability icons with visuals inspired by the Ashen Knight aesthetic.

This mod updates all ability icons to better match the darker, gothic tone of the Ashen Knight skin, creating a more cohesive and immersive in-game experience.

Changes
Updated Q, W, E, and R icons
Redesigned to fit Ashen Knight’s muted, dark, and spectral theme
Clean, readable visuals that stay true to gameplay clarity
Notes
Icons were created using AI-assisted tools and refined for in-game use

A simple visual upgrade for players who want Pyke’s abilities to match his Ashen Knight look.
